description: List leads - unconverted enquiries, which are a separate record type from jobs and estimates. Filter by customer, or sort by most recently updated to see what moved. A lead does not carry a call recording, a transcript or a text thread, and neither does anything else on this API - so this is not the place to look for one after a job and a customer came back without it.

newest_first.description: Sort by most recently updated rather than the default order

name: hcp_list_leads
